new.title: AI Day Seoul Brings Together Korea’s Industry Leaders, Startups and Developer Communities
new.summary: Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents.
